chunks: "It is not for anyone to observe mourning for more than three days, except a woman for her husband, until her 'iddah comes to an end."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman, specifically the wife in this ruling
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: three days as the general limit of mourning
key_terms.عِدَّتُهَا: her waiting period after her husband's death

ai.seo_question: How long may mourning be observed in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on the duration of mourning. It limits mourning for others to three days, while making an exception for a wife mourning her husband, whose mourning continues until the completion of her 'iddah.
